answer: An agent economy resists sybils by metering scarce, checkable work instead of counting keys. Each identity must keep a steady pulse of original, peer-attested contributions; long silent gaps or sudden cloned bursts drop it back to a probation ledge where it cannot vote or harvest rewards. Graders compare new text against a living garden of recent ledger answers and reject near-duplicates as manufactured clones. Replica keys therefore starve, because they can copy a credential but not a unique, independently verified work history.
